origins.section: Merging Look-Alike Code Ties Two Formats Together, and a Change for One Breaks the Other
A Flag for Each Caller Keeps the Method Shared, and Every Change Must Be Checked Against Both
Inlining the Method Back Gives Each Format Its Own Code, and All Checks Pass
The Rule of Three Is a Heuristic for When You Can't Yet Tell

recorded.prompt:q-merged-weight-format: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-merged-weight-format: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-merged-weight-format: The bank developer fixes Fields.split for the bank; the catalog check then fails: 'FAILED  catalog: 27" monitor ... IndexOutOfBoundsException'. 'Merging look-alike code ties two formats together. The bank's quote handling, made in the shared Fields.split, broke every catalog line with an inch mark.'
recorded.prompt:q-flag-branch-reaches: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-flag-branch-reaches: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-flag-branch-reaches: 'A flag separates the callers only where the body reads it ... a line added inside a branch runs for every caller that takes that branch.'
recorded.prompt:q-inline-digest: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-inline-digest: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-inline-digest: 'Copy the method's body into each caller, replace each parameter with the value that caller passes, and delete what can no longer run.' For the catalog 'both flags are false, so the quote branch and the line that drops an empty last field never run' and they are gone from CatalogImport.
recorded.prompt:q-second-voucher-copy: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-second-voucher-copy: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-second-voucher-copy: 'A second copy of one rule, such as unit 8.3.1's username check, gets one home at once, because the copies must change together and the next fix would reach only one of them.'

gates.says: all 12 of this quiz's discriminating readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-merged-weight-format:a: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-merged-weight-format:a: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-merged-weight-format:a: Outcome right, reason refuted: 'The two loops were the same text for two file formats, one owned by the bank and one by the supplier. Unit 8.3.1's test (must one copy change when the other does?) answered no before the extraction.' The page shows identical bodies need not be one rule.
recorded.prompt:q-merged-weight-format:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-merged-weight-format:c: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-merged-weight-format:c: The catalog calls Fields.split with its own lines, yet the bank's change to the body broke it: 'The new loop read it as an opening quote ... and returned one field.'
recorded.prompt:q-merged-weight-format:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-merged-weight-format:d: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-merged-weight-format:d: 'Friday's deploy changed only the bank-statement import ... and the bank team's tests passed. Nobody on that team opened the catalog code.' The catalog still broke, so tests changed for one caller do not shield the other (by inference from the opening scenario and the FAILED output).
recorded.prompt:q-flag-branch-reaches:a: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-flag-branch-reaches:a: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-flag-branch-reaches:a: 'a line added inside a branch runs for every caller that takes that branch' -- the finance export passes totals=true, so it takes the branch.
recorded.prompt:q-flag-branch-reaches:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-flag-branch-reaches:b: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-flag-branch-reaches:b: 'A flag separates the callers only where the body reads it: the drop line sat outside every flag, so it ran for both.'
recorded.prompt:q-flag-branch-reaches:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-flag-branch-reaches:d: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-flag-branch-reaches:d: Outcome right, reason refuted only by inference: the page attributes reach to which branch a caller takes ('runs for every caller that takes that branch'), and its tests are said only to catch a break 'only if they hold the case', never to route a change.
recorded.prompt:q-inline-digest:a: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-inline-digest:a: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-inline-digest:a: Inlining includes 'delete what can no longer run'; the inlined CatalogImport contains no quote branch or drop line.
recorded.prompt:q-inline-digest:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-inline-digest:b: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-inline-digest:b: The page's procedure replaces each parameter with the caller's value and deletes dead branches; the catalog result keeps no flags. Design note: 'delete what each caller doesn't need'. Refutation of the 'later request' reason is by inference.
recorded.prompt:q-inline-digest:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-inline-digest:d: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-inline-digest:d: The inlined StatementImport keeps the quote branch and drop line that only the bank ran ('the body stays as it is'), so inlining keeps what each caller runs, not only the common lines.
recorded.prompt:q-second-voucher-copy:a: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-second-voucher-copy:a: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-second-voucher-copy:a: 'The count decides nothing when you already know the answer.' The rule of three is 'a heuristic for when you can't yet tell'.
recorded.prompt:q-second-voucher-copy:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-second-voucher-copy:b: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-second-voucher-copy:b: 'A second copy of one rule ... gets one home at once, because the copies must change together and the next fix would reach only one of them.' The voucher rule is one rule; that it is not owned per channel is by inference from the stem's single rule.
recorded.prompt:q-second-voucher-copy:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-second-voucher-copy:c: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-second-voucher-copy:c: Outcome right, reason refuted: 'Three importers that each split a line are three formats, and the third copy is no reason to merge them'; 'look-alike copies of different rules stay apart at any count.'
